paper.title_en: Free field realization of the BMS Ising model
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we study the inhomogeneous BMS free fermion theory, and show that it gives a free field realization of the BMS Ising model. We find that besides the BMS symmetry there exists an anisotropic scaling symmetry in BMS free fermion theory. As a result, the symmetry of the theory gets enhanced to an infinite dimensional symmetry generated by a new type of BMS-Kac-Moody algebra, different from the one found in the BMS free scalar model. Besides the different coupling of the $u(1)$ Kac-Moody current to the BMS algebra, the Kac-Moody level is nonvanishing now such that the corresponding modules are further enlarged to BMS-Kac-Moody staggered modules. We show that there exists an underlying $W(2,2,1)$ structure in the operator product expansion of the currents, and the BMS-Kac-Moody staggered modules can be viewed as highest-weight modules of this $W$-algebra. Moreover we obtain the BMS Ising model by a fermion-boson duality. This BMS Ising model is not a minimal model with respect to BMS$_3$, since the minimal model construction based on BMS Kac determinant always leads to chiral Virasoro minimal models. Instead, the underlying algebra of the BMS Ising model is the $W(2,2,1)$-algebra, which can be understood as a quantum conformal BMS$_3$ algebra.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究 BMS 自由费米子理论，给出 BMS Ising 模型的自由场实现，涉及无限维 BMS-Kac-Moody 代数、交错模以及 W(2,2,1) 结构，理论深度较高，对 BMS 对称性与二维场论交叉方向的研究者具有较强参考价值。
decision.title_zh: BMS Ising 模型的自由场实现
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了非均匀 BMS 自由费米子理论，并表明它给出了 BMS Ising 模型的一个自由场实现。我们发现，除了 BMS 对称性之外，BMS 自由费米子理论中还存在一个各向异性标度对称性。因此，该理论的对称性被增强为一个由新型 BMS-Kac-Moody 代数生成的无限维对称性，该代数不同于在 BMS 自由标量模型中发现的代数。除了 $u(1)$ Kac-Moody 流与 BMS 代数的耦合方式不同之外，Kac-Moody 能级现在非零，从而相应的模被进一步扩大为 BMS-Kac-Moody 交错模。我们表明，在流的算符乘积展开中存在一个潜在的 $W(2,2,1)$ 结构，并且 BMS-Kac-Moody 交错模可以被视为该 $W$-代数的高权模。此外，我们通过费米子-玻色子对偶性得到了 BMS Ising 模型。这个 BMS Ising 模型相对于 BMS$_3$ 并不是一个极小模型，因为基于 BMS Kac 行列式的极小模型构造总是导致手征 Virasoro 极小模型。相反，BMS Ising 模型的基础代数是 $W(2,2,1)$-代数，它可以被理解为一个量子共形 BMS$_3$ 代数。
